name: socialfaktory
title: SocialFaktory
description: Write X and LinkedIn posts in your brand's voice, and track scheduled posts and credits across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and Pinterest.
author: adif_sgaid

commands.name: write-post
commands.title: Write Post
commands.subtitle: SocialFaktory
commands.description: Write three post variants in your brand's voice from a short brief, for X or LinkedIn.

commands.name: scheduled-posts
commands.title: Scheduled Posts
commands.subtitle: SocialFaktory
commands.description: Browse your scheduled, published and failed posts with their time, release link and metrics.

commands.name: credit-balance
commands.title: Credit Balance
commands.subtitle: SocialFaktory
commands.description: Show the credits available, reserved and in total in your SocialFaktory wallet.

tools.name: list-brands
tools.title: List Brands
tools.description: List the SocialFaktory brands the user can act for, with their ID, name, description, language and status. Call it first to find the brand ID that writing a post needs.

tools.name: list-posts
tools.title: List Posts
tools.description: List the user's social media posts with their status, scheduled time, publish time, platform, caption, release link and metrics. Can filter by brand and status.

tools.name: write-post
tools.title: Write Post
tools.description: Write up to three post variants in a brand's voice from a brief, for X or LinkedIn, and return their text. A new brief reserves 3 SocialFaktory credits; the same brand, platform and brief again within 30 minutes returns the same write and reserves nothing, unless you signed in again in between. It never publishes or schedules anything.

tools.name: get-wallet
tools.title: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Read the user's SocialFaktory credit balance: the credits available to spend, the credits reserved by work in progress, and the total.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Optional. A personal access token from SocialFaktory Settings > API tokens. Leave it empty to sign in with your browser.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
